scope: Fix iPhone microphone rejection caused by playback audio-session mode
cause: captureMicrophone called resume in playback mode before getUserMedia, changing to play-and-record only after receiving the stream. WebKit rejects getUserMedia in playback mode.
change: Keep play-and-record mode before capture and during pending microphone permission, including concurrent resume calls. Restore playback after rejection and prior session type on close. Preserve gesture-time capture, shared request, cancellation and stream reuse.

regressions: Assert recording mode within getUserMedia, before stream delivery.
Resume during pending permission retains recording mode; rejection restores playback; close restores original type.
validation.physicalIPhone: Awaiting user retest; no physical iPhone available to agent.

workBounds.microphoneRequests: Existing single shared request; no automatic retry.

deployment: Hosting only after commit/push. Keep issue 92 open pending iPhone and wider connection validation.
